title: Backup
description: A backup of a database branch.

id.description: The unique identifier of the backup.

state.description: The current state of the backup.

size.description: The size of the backup in bytes.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the backup was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the backup was last updated.

completed_at.description: The timestamp when the backup completed.

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the backup expires.
